parts.label: Part 1
parts.article:
Good morning. Thanks for coming in today. Could you start by telling me your full name, please?

Yes, of course. My full name is Sarah Merrivale.

Great. So, I understand you’re currently working at a company called Office Solutions. Could you tell me a bit about your job there?

Sure. Office Solutions is a company that focuses on selling furniture, mainly office-related items like desks, chairs, filing cabinets, and so on.

That sounds interesting. And what exactly is your role?

Well, I work as a coordinator in the advertising department. My main responsibilities include managing marketing campaigns, handling promotional materials, and working with designers to create advertisements for online and print platforms.

I see. How long have you been in that role?

I took on the coordinator position in January last year. So, it’s been a little over a year now. Before that, I was working in customer service at the same company.

Right. That’s a good bit of experience. Now, let’s talk about your qualifications. Do you have any educational background relevant to this role?

Yes. I hold a diploma in finance, which I completed about three years ago. It gave me a strong foundation in managing budgets, financial planning, and business operations.

That’s useful. Are you currently studying anything?

Yes. I’m actually doing a certificate in tourism at the moment. It’s an evening course. So, I can study while still working full time. I decided to take it because I’d love to move into the hospitality industry.

That makes sense. Now, I see that you speak another language. Can you tell me more about that?

Of course. I speak Italian quite well. I took classes for a few years and then spent some time in Italy practicing with native speakers. I wouldn’t say I’m fluent, but I can hold a conversation comfortably.

That’s great. Do you have any hobbies or activities you do in your free time, Sarah?

Yes. I do. One of my favorite things to do is dancing. I go to a dance class once a week, usually on Saturdays, and it’s a great way to relax and stay active.

That sounds fun. Now, let’s move on to why you’re interested in this position at Hampton Hostel. What made you apply?

Well, there are a few reasons. Firstly, I’ve always wanted to work in hospitality, and this role seems like a great fit. I also love interacting with people from different backgrounds, which I think is a key part of working at a hostel.

I agree. And I see you’re involved in some volunteer work as well.

Yes. In my spare time, I enjoy volunteering at museums. I help with guided tours and visitor information, which has been a fantastic way to learn about history and improve my communication skills.

That’s really valuable experience. Are there any particular aspects of hospitality that interest you?

Yes. I’m particularly interested in guest services, making sure that visitors feel welcome, handling inquiries, and ensuring their stay is enjoyable. I think it’s a really important part of running a successful hostel.

Absolutely. Now, if you get the role, one of your responsibilities will be helping guests navigate the area. Would you be comfortable with that?

Oh, yes, definitely. I enjoy helping people find their way around, and I’d be happy to provide a map to guests, whether it’s for sightseeing, public transport, or local attractions. I already do this a lot when friends visit from out of town.

That’s great to hear. Well, thank you for your time today, Sarah. We’ll review your application and get back to you soon.

Thank you. I look forward to hearing from you.

analyses.content: Sarah 介绍她目前任职的 Office Solutions 公司主要业务是销售 furniture（家具），例如办公桌椅。
Office Solutions is a company that focuses on selling furniture, mainly office-related items like desks, chairs, filing cabinets, and so on。
听到公司名称后定位。录音中虽然列举了 desks, chairs 等具体物品，但题目要求填入它们所属的总称 furniture。
Well, I work as a coordinator in the advertising department。
听到 coordinator 定位。随后她提到了 marketing campaigns（营销活动），那属于她的工作内容，而部门名称应锁定为 advertising department。
Sarah 在公司里担任 advertising（广告）部门的协调员。
I took on the coordinator position in January last year。
听到 Time as coordinator 后定位。注意区分她在这家公司工作的总时长和在这个特定岗位上的时长。
她是从去年 January（一月）开始担任协调员这一职位的。
I hold a diploma in finance, which I completed about three years ago。
听到 diploma 后捕捉专业名词。这个背景为她管理预算和业务运营打下了基础。
Sarah 在三年前完成了一个 finance（金融）专业的文凭课程。
I’m actually doing a certificate in tourism at the moment。
听到 certificate 定位。她同时提到了 hospitality industry（款待业），那是她的目标行业，而目前正在学习的课程名称是 tourism。
为了进入酒店服务业，她目前正在修读 tourism（旅游业）的证书课程。
除了英语，Sarah 还能流利地使用 Italian（意大利语）进行交流。
I speak Italian quite well。
听到 language 后定位。虽然她说自己不是 fluent（精通），但能 comfortably（自如地）对话，符合题干 can speak... well 的描述。
原文 “One of my favorite things to do is dancing” 直接给出爱好 dancing；后文 “once a week” 对应题目中的频率，因此填 dancing。
不要误填后文 dance class 中的 dance。题目已有 goes，填 dancing 构成 goes dancing（去跳舞）；goes dance 不符合语法。
One of my favorite things to do is dancing. I go to a dance class once a week, usually on Saturdays。
In my spare time, I enjoy volunteering at museums。
听到 volunteer 后定位。注意捕捉表示地点的复数名词。
在业余时间，Sarah 喜欢在 museums（博物馆）担任志愿者。
I’m particularly interested in guest services, making sure that visitors feel welcome, handling inquiries, and ensuring their stay is enjoyable。
听到 aspects of hospitality 后定位。卷面已给出的 Interested in learning about 对应原文的 particularly interested in。
她对酒店服务中的客房服务（guest services）特别感兴趣。
I’d be happy to provide a map to guests, whether it’s for sightseeing, public transport, or local attractions。
听到 navigate the area 定位。卷面的 giving out 对应原文的 provide。
如果获得这份工作，她的一项职责是为客人提供 map（地图）并指引方向。
